all_source_headers.name: gcd_le_divisor_sum
all_source_headers.header:
theorem gcd_le_divisor_sum {a : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    a.gcd n ≤ ∑ d ∈ a.divisors, if d ∣ n then d else 0

all_source_headers.name: sum_divisor_majorant
all_source_headers.header:
theorem sum_divisor_majorant (a N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, ∑ d ∈ a.divisors, if d ∣ n then d else 0) =
      ∑ d ∈ a.divisors, d * (N / d)

all_source_headers.name: sum_gcd_le_divisor_floor
all_source_headers.header:
theorem sum_gcd_le_divisor_floor {a : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, a.gcd n) ≤ ∑ d ∈ a.divisors, d * (N / d)

all_source_headers.name: sum_gcd_le
all_source_headers.header:
theorem sum_gcd_le {a : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, a.gcd n) ≤ N * a.divisors.card

all_source_headers.name: largeGCDPairs
all_source_headers.header: def largeGCDPairs (N : Finset ℕ) (Y : ℝ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)

all_source_headers.name: sum_gcd_pairs_le_log
all_source_headers.header:
theorem sum_gcd_pairs_le_log {T : ℝ} (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (N : Finset ℕ) (hN : N ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊T⌋₊) :
    (∑ p ∈ N ×ˢ N, (p.1.gcd p.2 : ℝ)) ≤ T ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log T)

all_source_headers.name: card_largeGCDPairs_le
all_source_headers.header:
theorem card_largeGCDPairs_le {T Y : ℝ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (N : Finset ℕ) (hN : N ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊T⌋₊) :
    ((largeGCDPairs N Y).card : ℝ) ≤ T ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log T) / Y

all_source_headers.name: sum_abs_pair_mul_le_sqrt_card
all_source_headers.header:
theorem sum_abs_pair_mul_le_sqrt_card {ι : Type*}
    (N : Finset ι) (S : Finset (ι × ι)) (hS : S ⊆ N ×ˢ N) (β : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ p ∈ S, |β p.1 * β p.2|) ≤
      Real.sqrt (S.card : ℝ) * ∑ n ∈ N, β n ^ 2

all_source_headers.name: sum_abs_largeGCDPairs_le
all_source_headers.header:
theorem sum_abs_largeGCDPairs_le {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {T Y : ℝ}
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (N : Finset ℕ) (hN : N ⊆ Ioc 0 ⌊T⌋₊) (β : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hβ : ∀ n ∈ N, |β n| ≤ (fouvryTau k n : ℝ)) :
    (∑ p ∈ largeGCDPairs N Y, |β p.1 * β p.2|) ≤
      T ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log T) ^ (k ^ 2 - 1) *
        Real.sqrt ((1 + Real.log T) / Y)

all_source_headers.name: MediumAtom.betaCarrier_subset_twiceV
all_source_headers.header:
theorem MediumAtom.betaCarrier_subset_twiceV {d : MediumAtom} (hV : 1 ≤ d.V) :
    d.betaCarrier ⊆ Ioc 0 (Nat.floor (2 * d.V))

all_source_headers.name: MediumAtom.cleanedBeta_norm_le_tauPow
all_source_headers.header:
theorem MediumAtom.cleanedBeta_norm_le_tauPow
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ d.betaCarrier) :
    ‖d.cleanedBeta n‖ ≤ (fouvryTau (2 ^ B) n : ℝ)

all_source_headers.name: MediumAtom.commonLargeBetaGCDCleanMass_le
all_source_headers.header:
theorem MediumAtom.commonLargeBetaGCDCleanMass_le
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) {Y : ℝ} (hY : 0 < Y) :
    d.commonLargeBetaGCDCleanMass Y ≤
      (2 * d.V) ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ ((2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1) *
        Real.sqrt ((1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) / Y)

all_source_headers.name: commonLargeBetaGCDW_polynomial_residue_largeGCD_bound
all_source_headers.header:
theorem commonLargeBetaGCDW_polynomial_residue_largeGCD_bound (kappa : ℝ) {epsilon : ℝ}
    (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (B : ℕ) (sigma c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d → ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y →
        ‖d.commonLargeBetaGCDW Y‖ ≤
          C * d.U * d.scale ^ epsilon *
            ((2 * d.V) ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ ((2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1) *
              Real.sqrt ((1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) / Y)) +
            ‖d.commonLargeBetaGCDException Y‖
